package.author: Matt Enarle
package.description: A local-first Markdown editor with live preview, reading mode, diagrams and AI context bundles.

en-US.author: Matt Enarle
en-US.description: A local-first Markdown editor with live preview, reading mode, diagrams and AI context bundles.
en-US.longDescription:
A local markdown editor for the notes you share with AI.
marka.md keeps notes on your own machine and opens them as ordinary Markdown files. Editing offers live preview, a reading mode, themes and diagrams, so a note can be written, reviewed and presented in the same window.
Context bundles collect the notes an AI assistant should see for a task, which is the workflow the editor is organised around: keep the material local, then hand over exactly the context a model needs.
en-US.name: marka.md
en-US.releaseNotes:
v1.7.10
v1.7.10 makes large Markdown previews more responsive and lets PDF exports use your selected font.
fixed
- Reduce direction-handling overhead in large previews by avoiding redundant updates on LTR prose blocks. Mixed RTL/LTR text, explicit reading direction, code, and diagrams retain their direction handling (#195).
- Keep syntax-highlighted code monospace in PDF exports with every prose font.
- Wrap long URLs and filenames within printed pages.
- Keep simultaneous exports with identical filenames separate so one export cannot overwrite another.
PDF fonts
- PDF exports now follow Settings > Reading > preview and print font: Inter, system, or mono (#196).
- Include the bundled Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts in print documents when needed, and wait for fonts to finish loading before opening the print dialog.
- Select mono to export headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables in monospace without installing an extra font.
maintenance
- Updated the opener plugin to 2.7.2 in both Rust and JavaScript, the single-instance plugin to 2.5.5, and tauri-build to 2.7.4.
notes
- Thanks to @zenbao for the detailed large-preview performance report and @arijit4 for the print-font suggestion.
- Signed updater artifacts remain enabled.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 Markdown 编辑器，支持实时预览、阅读模式、图表与 AI 上下文打包。
zh-CN.longDescription:
为那些要和 AI 一起使用的 Markdown 笔记而做的本地编辑器。
marka.md 把笔记保存在你自己的电脑上，并以普通 Markdown 文件打开。编辑时提供实时预览、阅读模式、主题与图表，一篇笔记可以在同一个窗口里写完、看完并展示出来。
上下文打包会把需要交给 AI 助手的笔记汇集起来，这也是这个编辑器围绕的核心工作流：素材留在本地，只把模型真正需要的上下文交出去。
